description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade controller for the OpenCart installation upgrade process. It initializes the upgrade page with necessary data and loads various components for the upgrade step in the admin interface.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: A controller class for the upgrade process in the OpenCart installation, extending the core system Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data and loads views for the upgrade page, setting the page title, server URL, count of upgrade files, and including header, footer, and sidebar components.
